For each, 6 lag correlations (k=2,3,4,6,9,15 frames; modulation periods 67-500 ms) per cochlear channel + channel-averaged lag profile + per-frame peak. Plus 2 cross-tau/cross-compression difference summaries. Captures PER-BAND envelope periodicity at multiple temporal scales and compression regimes. Single-tau version reached 0.0768 — extending to 4 combos to push further. All closed-form, 0 trained params.

subject: patient1
description: Proven 0.0767 base + PB-EBAC (per-band envelope autocorrelogram, +0.0001) + NEW DIM: CROSS-CHANNEL LAGGED ENVELOPE CORRELATION. Per-frame running normalized correlation between ADJACENT cochlear bands at temporal lags +/-2 and +/-4 frames (67/133 ms). For 19 adjacent pairs, captures FORMANT TRANSITIONS (energy traveling across the cochlea over time). Positive lag = energy moves down-frequency; negative lag = up-frequency. Plus channel-summary means and up/down asymmetry per band-pair. Distinct from STMF (rate-scale tuning) and EBAC (within-channel periodicity): this captures BETWEEN-channel temporal coupling. All closed-form, 0 trained params.
